auth.why: To read the user's email receipts (read-only) and match them against open class-action settlements. The connector never sends, replies to, forwards, or deletes mail.

description: Matches your email receipts against open class-action settlements, prepares pre-filled claim packs, and takes 20% only when you confirm a payout. You always file the claim yourself; the connector never files or auto-charges.

proactive_triggers.description: A Gmail receipt matches an open settlement's purchase criteria

tools.description: List currently-open class-action settlements with deadlines and a data-freshness warning
tools.name: list_settlements

tools.description: Scan receipts against open settlements ('gmail' read-only, or 'fixtures' demo data); emits settlement_match life events
tools.name: scan_receipts

tools.description: List all settlement matches found so far
tools.name: get_matches

tools.description: Build the filing pack for a match: eligibility checklist, filing steps, pre-filled info sheet. The user files the claim; this never files anything.
tools.name: generate_claim_pack

tools.description: Save a card for the later fee. Response carries the exact fee disclosure first: 20% of the confirmed payout, charged only if the user confirms the payout.
tools.name: setup_billing

tools.description: User confirms the settlement paid out; charges the 20% fee off-session against the saved card
tools.name: confirm_payout
receive_life_event
tools.description: Shared-bus receiver: log a detected life event, create a draft match, and return the proactive nudge
